notes.title: The Last Hope REMASTERED UPDATE is now live!
notes.notes:
This is the most important patch was even made for The Last Hope.

- The original ”The Last Hope” was made in game engine Unity 5.3.4. The build was exported in Unity 5.5.1 and after some work on graphics, the game looks far more beautiful. Below are some examples(BEFORE/AFTER & AFTER/BEFORE);
- Player run now with a twice higher speed in all countries;
- Level with boat was removed;
- In U.K. & Germany were fixed some minor bugs;
